services.desc: Hidden deep within an ancient jungle, the entrance to a forgotten temple lies buried with centuries of secrets. The legend of the Serpent Sanctum has been whispered across generations, but none who have ventured inside have ever returned. Once said to be a sacred site for the worship of the feathered serpent god, its dwellers performed mystical rituals to unlock the universe’s deepest mysteries. Down a nondescript corridor, past the old library and beyond the general store, you will find Madam Zita’s curiosites - a burial ground for her collection of wicked artifacts that time has long but forgotten. blurb: Guests participate in immersive Puzzle Adventure Escape Rooms called chapters, each with a unique theme and story. Each experience lasts 60 minutes and involves solving puzzles to progress. The rooms are designed for mental participation and some physical accessibility, suitable for children ages 8 and up with adult supervision for ages 8-15.
